result.title: Visual Sufficiency Landscapes: Understanding Query-Conditioned Reliability in Visual Token Pruning
result.summary: Different visual token pruning strategies retain different subsets while maintaining similar task performance. This motivates a combinatorial question: how many visual subsets can preserve model behavior, and how does their abundance depend on the query? We introduce visual sufficiency landscapes to characterize this abundance. At a fixed layer and budget, visual sufficiency probability is the fraction of uniformly sampled subsets that jointly preserve the dense model's answer, reference-answer likelihood, and output distribution. Independent sampling replicates separate input variation from estimation noise. Across Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL2-8B, and LLaVA-v1.5-7B, differences between inputs on GQA and TextVQA exceed replication error, and different questions about the same GQA image produce distinct landscapes. Sufficiency probability also improves failure prediction for full pruning methods. On LLaVA, adding this probability increases AUC by 0.1151 for FastV, 0.0683 for VisionZip, and 0.1401 for SparseVLM, while reducing log loss and Brier score. Several architecture-adapted configurations on the other two models reproduce these gains. Under controlled selection rules, predictors trained on the original images reduce log loss on new images by 9.0%, 13.0%, and 14.1%, respectively. These results establish successful-subset abundance as a measurable dimension of local prunability and connect it to the identification of high-risk pruning conditions.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「视觉充分性景观」，在固定层与预算下用均匀采样的视觉 token 子集，统计能同时保持密集模型答案、参考答案似然与输出分布的子集比例，并在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL2-8B、LLaVA-v1.5-7B 上考察该比例随输入与 query 的变化，以及它对剪枝失败预测的增益。
AI.relevance_reason: 该度量刻画视觉 token 子集保持模型行为的充裕程度，与视觉细节保留、信息坍缩及视觉证据筛选的主线问题直接相关；其「同一图像不同 query 产生不同景观」的发现可供核查 LVR 中 query 条件化的视觉信息需求与剪枝可靠性评估。
